episodes.title: Inside Samuel Bateman’s Cult - Nomz Tells Her Full Story
episodes.description: Nomz, featured in Netflix's Trust Me: The False Prophet, joins Brooke Goff to tell the story behind Samuel Bateman, the FLDS world she grew up in, and the experiences that changed her life forever. Nomz opens up about being raised in Short Creek, growing up believing in the FLDS faith, resisting Samuel Bateman before eventually becoming his 13th wife, and the psychological control that kept her trapped in his world. She also discusses the infamous traffic stop seen in the Netflix documentary, her arrest and time in prison, and the moment she finally began questioning everything she had been taught. Now on the other side, Nomz talks about rebuilding her life, discovering music, finding freedom, and her surprising relationship with Warren Jeffs' son. This is Nomz's story beyond the documentary — in her own words.
